PénTech, SME invoice factoring startup joins 365.fintech portfolio

365.fintech invested in PénTech, a Budapest-based startup building a digital invoice factoring solution for small and medium enterprises.

PénTech's smart factoring solution enables businesses to access liquidity and unlock working capital within 24 hours via its digital-first platform. The startup is a graduate of MKB Fintechlab accelerator and has recently won a 1st prize at FintechShow, the most prestigious digital financial event in Hungary.

365.fintech participated in a pre-seed financing round, which will enable the company to roll out its solution in the Hungarian market first, with plans to expand to further Central and Eastern European markets.

We have decided to invest in PénTech given the combination of a driven and complementary founding team and significant market opportunity in the SME lending space.

Rudolf Vrábel, Managing Director at 365.fintech explains: “We believe the needs of small and medium businesses are underserved. Short-term liquidity issues are one of the key pain points for the entrepreneurs - and this is especially true in Central and Eastern Europe. We are excited to support PénTech in rolling out its smart factoring solution in Hungary and beyond.”

365.fintech invests with Startup Wise Guys

We are more than happy to announce that 365.fintech has recently closed an investment deal with Startup Wise Guys.

Startup Wise Guys is one of the most successful B2B startup accelerators in Europe with particular focus on Baltics and Central and Eastern Europe. The accelerator is a great fit with our investment thesis to focus on supporting pre-seed and seed fintech ventures in CEE and beyond.

Since 2012, Startup Wise Guys has run 15 accelerator batches and their 145 portfolio startups boast a survival rate of 77%, a testament to the high quality of their early stage portfolio.

365.fintech is becoming an investor in two Startup Wise Guys batches focused purely on fintech and associated verticals such as PropTech, RegTech, Cybersecurity, Blockchain and InsurTech. 

The fintech acceleration will focus on both pre-product market fit startups and companies with early evidence of recurring revenue.

We are already looking forward to be working with Startup Wise Guys on the next fintech batch which will be launching in autumn 2019 in Vilnius, Lithuania!

365.fintech invests in Dateio, a card-linked offers startup

365.fintech started out the year 2019 by investing in Dateio. The investment platform acquired 5.3% stake in this established fintech startup from Czech Republic and Slovakia. The investment’s aim is to keep advancing current product synergies as well as enabling penetration of new foreign markets for the Prague-based company.

Dateio and 365.bank have been cooperating successfully by implementing a loyalty rewards platform Peniaze s5. Today, bank’s clients can take advantage of cashback-based discounts based at more than 60 merchant locations.

„In the recent months, Dateio has shown exponential increase in sales as well as in the total number of clients. This is why we see this investment as an amazing opportunity for continuing and developing our current cooperation and mutual synergies“, explained Rudolf Vrábel, Managing Director 365.fintech regarding future cooperation potential with Dateio.

Dateio started out its operations in 2013. During its relatively short existence, the company managed to close cooperation deals with almost ten European banks and onboarded hundreds of thousands of clients. It operates a rewards platform for banks, which is based on card-linked marketing. The company transforms data into actionable insights which help banks to understand buying behaviour of their client base better. It enables personalized discount offerings to banks’ clients when shopping at partner merchants. On the merchant side, it drives new customer acquisition while strengthening loyalty with existing customers.

„We are very pleased to able to further broaden our cooperation with the 365.fintech ecosystem. We perceive the investment into our company as a significant showcase of trust and proof that we are on the right track. We are convinced it will help us to further fuel our growth and scale our customer acquisition effort,“ explains Ondřej Knot, co-founder of Dateio.

 

About 365.fintech

365.fintech is a CEE based investment platform focused on providing financing and support for early to scale-up stage technology startups focusing on innovative FinTech, InsurTech as well as Big Data startups with global aspirations. Besides financing, 365.fintech is uniquely positioned to enable its portfolio companies to develop, test and pilot their products and services in a live regulated setting.

365.fintech secured its first large investments also thanks to the help from The Booster Labs - experts on incubation and investing into Fintechs

365.fintech is a newly launched investment platform whose goal is to support the Fintech ecosystem by investing in Slovak start-ups and cooperating with leading multinational start-ups from the financial sector. With this objective, 365.fintech partnered up with innovation studio The Booster Labs, whose team is dedicated to development of new Fintech products and value propositions – and has a long-term expertise in foreign and domestic start-up investments. The cooperation has already brought about its first successful investments and partnerships.

Thanks to the cooperation with Booster Labs, 365.fintech has already invested in Austrian venture capital fund Speedinvest f and afterwards sealed the deal with  Dutch fund Finch Capital. ‘We are extremely happy with the cooperation and believe that thanks to the shared vision and dedication for work with start-ups, it will continue to be successful’ explained Daniel Hajdiak, board member of 365.fintech.

The main goal of 365.fintech is to invest mostly in regional start-ups with product synergies with the 365 ecosystem, however, it also aims to cooperate with large venture capital funds. This is where Booster Labs team’s expertise and professional network proved to be particularly helpful.

 “The cooperation between 365.fintech and The Booster Labs begun in the beginning of 2018, whereas our current and new form of cooperation is active since October 2018. We set up an investment strategy together and actively monitor the Slovak market as well as the Central-European start-up market.”Added Peter Gabriž, co-founder of The Booster Labs.

The Booster Labs team set-up the first start-up accelerator aimed at helping and financing fintech start-ups in Central Europe. It also has experience in working with international funds such as Anthemis Group – a prestigious fund based in London with expertise in investing in financial services and technology start-ups.

Besides the cooperation with 365.fintech, The Booster Labs invests in start-ups itself and has seen several successful investments, such as Fidor Bank - neobank based in Germany or Albert, a United Kingdom based start-up, which has been acquired recently by Santander. The Booster Labs also incubates Slovak fintech start-ups such as Payowallet or Papaya POS.

365.fintech, a startup investment platform launches as a core component of the 365 ecosystem

Supporting the Slovak startup scene and implementing new ideas and technology. Those are the main goals of 365.fintech which aims to invest 2 million euros of capital in its inception phase. The main focus of the investment platform will be financial services and big data startups.

Prior to launching its public beta, 365.bank is introducing a startup investment platform 365.fintech. It is designed to support implementation of innovative technology and services from startups towards the bank’s ecosystem and at the same time support the startups in their further development and growth.

 „Our goal is to build up a complex ecosystem to meaningfully support startups in their business. Beginning from presenting challenges to igniting innovative early ideas, mentoring and financing to hands-on cooperation projects with startups. Besides these activities, we are working on cooperating with Tier 1 European ventures capital funds focused on financial services in a limited partnership investment model,“ said Andrej Zaťko, charmain of the 365.fintech supervisory board.

365.fintech will primarily focus on startups active in Slovakia and the broader CEE region. The cooperation models include direct investments, startup-friendly convertible loan financing and setting up the floor for testing, piloting and distributing startup products and services. Besides capital itself, startups will be able to access tailored advisory services. 365.fintech will further support innovation initiatives such hackathons and startup challenges.

„Supporting startups is core part of our DNA. Our bank is being built from the ground up in cooperation with startups and we plan on continuing on this path. This is a win-win relationship for the bank, startups as well as our clients,“ added Marek Šupa, CEO of 365.bank.

365.fintech and 365.bank are the initial building blocks of a nascent 3-pillar 365 ecosystem. The next integral component of the emergent ecosystem will be announced shortly.

About 365.fintech:
365.fintech is a CEE based investment platform focused on providing financing and support for early to scale-up stage technology startups focusing on innovative FinTech, InsurTech as well as Big Data startups with global aspirations. Besides financing, 365.fintech is uniquely positioned to enable its portfolio companies to develop, test and pilot their products and services in a live regulated setting.
